Diagnostics roadmap: stains → gene panels → blood tests that decide treatment
Surgery roadmap: radical operations → less surgery → no surgery when a drug has done the work
Chemotherapy roadmap: mustard gas → curative combinations → the warhead inside smarter drugs
Hormonal therapy roadmap: removing the ovaries → tamoxifen → oral degraders switched by a blood test
Epigenetic therapy roadmap: loosening silenced genes → mutation-specific enzymes → editing the epigenome
Supportive care and survivorship roadmap: making treatment bearable → proving it extends life → caring for tens of millions afterwards
AI in oncology roadmap: pattern readers → foundation models → agents in the workflow
Diet, exercise and lifestyle roadmap: causes established → interventions that disappointed → exercise proven as treatment
Devices and physical therapies roadmap: heat and light → electric fields and focused sound → drug-releasing implants
Radiotherapy roadmap: X-rays → shaped beams → fewer fractions, particles and FLASH
Targeted therapy roadmap: imatinib → designed for resistance → the undruggable drivers fall
Drug discovery roadmap: screening in mice → maps of dependency → designing in silico
Cancer prevention roadmap: tobacco control and vaccines → biomarker-guided chemoprevention → interception in carriers
Paediatric oncology roadmap: cooperative-group cures → engineered immunity → drugs developed for children first
Global access and affordability roadmap: essential medicines and generics → biosimilars and frugal trials → reliance, pooling and homegrown innovation
Trial modernisation roadmap: the randomised trial → platforms and adaptive designs → decentralised, pragmatic and always-on
